maria-partners: Nimbus filed a request to onboard nimbus-eu-lima region to marketplace. They want reserved GPUs + marketplace entitlement + customer KMS. Pilot window: Apr 18-22. Can we scope?

oliver-ops: Noted. Need exact SKU counts and whether they want dedicated tenant or shared reserved pool. Provider lead times vary by region.

jess-legal: We'll need an addendum for marketplace entitlements and KMS key handling. Also confirm data residency language.

anna-nimbus: Hi all 1f46b
We asked for 24 x A100-80GB, 6 x T4 for fallbacks, 1 Gbps sustained egress per org, and CMK allowed. Pilot is invite-only.

kevin-eng: From runtime: we validated models on similar hosts but not on nimbus-eu-lima image. I can run a 1k/2k token perf matrix and post results. If latency spikes we'll enable the quantized execution path.

maria-partners: Action items: oliver => open quota ticket; kevin => perf runs; jess => NDA addendum draft; anna => share partner contact/portal link. I'll schedule a partner kickoff next Tue.

marketplace-bot: Ticket #MP-7892 created (status: awaiting_provider_quota). ETA 6 business days.

oliver-ops: I'll open the provider ticket first thing Mon and sync procurement if we need reserved capacity.

jess-legal: Drafting addendum, aiming Thu EOD. Please DM partner legal contact.

kevin-eng: Will bench Mon and post numbers here. If we see >15% perf variance we'll patch runtime.

maria-partners: Thanks team. I'll share the kickoff invite once quota ticket is live. :rocket:
